claim: ADR 0340 rule 4, lane 3c. After make_menus_current, makeCurrent carries every menu it made current and, for a menu that came back already_current with carried_at NULL and a made_current_at, carries it again dated by that made_current_at; carryMenu sets carried_at (only where it is still NULL) when no line of the carry failed. A menu made current before carried_at existed is therefore carried again the first time it is chosen again (recorded in ADR 0340's Lane 3c corrections). Pinned by menus.service.spec.ts ('a carry that did not finish is finished by the retry').
